basic_details.job_title: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 18 Office Assistant, Consultant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey & Land Use Planning (ICAR-NBSS&LUP) will hold a walk-in interview on 7 December 2026 at 10:00 AM at ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning, Amravati Road, Nagpur-440033. Candidates must reach the venue before 10:00 AM. The interview is for 18 contract posts under the NSMP Project: Consultant (GIS), Consultant (Laboratory), Consultant (Field), Office Assistant and Supporting Staff (Laboratory), with emoluments from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 50,000/- per month.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-NBSS&LUP
content_sections.text: ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey & Land Use Planning is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research located on Amravati Road, Nagpur. The posts in this walk-in are for its NSMP Project, and the engagement lasts only as long as the project.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice lists five posts with a total of 18 vacancies. Each post's subject or area of specialisation, vacancies and monthly emoluments are below. Essential: Master's degree in Geoinformatics/Ag. Physics/RS&GIS/Soil Science/Soil Water Conservation/Spatial Science/Geography/Geology. Desirable: More than two years' experience in relevant field. Essential: Master's Degree in Soil Science/Microbiology/Chemistry/Env. Science. Desirable: More than one year experience in relevant field. Essential: Master's Degree in Soil Science/Microbiology/Chemistry/Env. Science/Geography/Geology. Desirable: More than one year experience in relevant field. Essential: Bachelor's Degree in Science/Commerce/Arts with knowledge in handling office work/GeM purchase/Basic knowledge in MS-Office and well versed in English Communication. H.Sc. with knowledge in handling laboratory glassware. The age for all five posts is between 21 to 45 years on the date of interview, with relaxation as per rules. The notice does not list the category-wise relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.subject_area_of_specialisation: Soil Sample processing and other laboratory work

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: An application on plain paper with a passport size photograph affixed on it. Attested copies of mark-sheets and certificates. Original certificates, which must be produced at the time of interview. CV.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reach the interview location at ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Amravati Road, Nagpur before 10:00 AM on 7 December 2026. Submit the documents on arrival. Candidates coming after 10:00 AM will not be allowed to enter for interview. If necessary, written tests and assignments may also be conducted before the interview. Candidates then face a panel interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on contract basis under the NSMP Project, on purely temporary basis initially for one year. The position is co-terminus with the project, and selected candidates shall not claim for regular appointment at NBSS&LUP/ICAR. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The decision of the Competent Authority, ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Nagpur will be final and binding in all respects. For queries, the notice prints Phone: 0712-2500545, 2500664 Extn. 106, 120 and Email: [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the ICAR-NBSS&LUP walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 7 December 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Candidates should reach ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning, Amravati Road, Nagpur-440033 before 10:00 AM. Those coming after 10:00 AM will not be allowed to enter for interview.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 18 vacancies: Consultant (GIS) 05, Consultant (Laboratory) 03, Consultant (Field) 03, Office Assistant 04 and Supporting Staff (Laboratory) 03.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Consultant (GIS) post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Geoinformatics/Ag. Physics/RS&GIS/Soil Science/Soil Water Conservation/Spatial Science/Geography/Geology is essential. More than two years' experience in relevant field is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for Office Assistant and Supporting Staff (Laboratory)?
faq.answer: Office Assistant needs a Bachelor's Degree in Science/Commerce/Arts with knowledge in handling office work/GeM purchase/basic knowledge in MS-Office and good English communication. Supporting Staff (Laboratory) needs H.Sc. with knowledge in handling laboratory glassware.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age for all posts is between 21 to 45 years on the date of interview, with relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Emoluments are Rs. 50,000/- per month for Consultant (GIS), Rs. 45,000/- for Consultant (Laboratory) and Consultant (Field), Rs. 35,000/- for Office Assistant and Rs. 25,000/- for Supporting Staff (Laboratory).

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring an application on plain paper with a passport size photograph affixed, attested copies of mark-sheets and certificates, original certificates and your CV.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a panel interview, and if necessary, written tests and assignments may also be conducted before the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and is TA/DA paid?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on contract under the NSMP Project, purely temporary and initially for one year, and is co-terminus with the project. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
